# `number_transfer_pin`

Area: **inventory** ([all tables](README.md))

Number Transfer PINs generated on request for a line's number; time-limited and single use. The PIN itself is shown once to the agent and never stored.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `subscriber_number_id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `product_id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `pin_hash` | `text` | no |  | sha256 over the PIN id and the PIN: the PIN is not stored. |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |
| `expires_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | Created at plus BSS_NUMBER_TRANSFER_PIN_DAYS; an expired PIN is refused at port-out. |
| `used_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  |  |
| `revoked_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | Set when a newer PIN replaced this one. |
